text:
release-manager: Quick heads-up — planned SDK cutover for py + ts clients at 16:00 UTC. We'll do a staged traffic shift 0→50→100 over 30m with a 10m observation window between steps. Please ack if you have any blockers.

maria: acked. docs update ready, will push deprecation note draft in ~30m.

simon: what's rollback criteria? 5xx increase? token cost spike? need clear SLOs.

release-manager: primary triggers: >3% p95 latency regression, >1.5x 5xx rate vs baseline, or error spike on `auth` calls. Any of those = immediate stop + rollback to previous dist-tag.

akshay: rolling canary today is the package bundle only, not runtime. For safety we'll keep the old dist-tag stable and shift traffic via `x-sdk-version` header routing in the gateway.

deploy-bot: Build 2026.3.17-rc2 published to npm and PyPI (unsigned wheels flagged). See artifact IDs: js@2.4.0-rc2, py==2.4.0rc2. Link: https://ci.internal/release/2026.3.17-rc2

maria: docs-team -> added a short deprecation blurb and migration snippet. I'll post PR link in a sec.

docs-team: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/482 — includes changelog excerpt and suggestion to pin to `@redwood/sdk@^2.3.0` if users want to avoid auto-updates.

simon: what about dist-tags? Are we doing `latest` move or using `staged`?

release-manager: plan: publish rc to `staged`, then after 30m of canary checks move `staged`→`canary` for 50% traffic, then `canary`→`latest` if green. Never move to `latest` until after final sign-off from @maria and @simon.

akshay: runbook note — to force rollback run:
```
# npm
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.3.5 latest
# pip
pip install redwood-sdk==2.3.5
```
We'll also flip header routing to the previous package.

maria: deprecation notification will go to the CHANGELOG and a short email to active users with 7-day grace. Draft ready in PR.

simon: ack. I'll monitor latency and error dashboards. + set an alert for any auth error rate > 0.5% in 5m.

release-manager: thanks — kicking off canary at 16:00 UTC. I'll post status updates here. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 16:00:02 UTC — 5% -> 50% traffic plan initiated. Rollout ID: r-2026-0317-rc2

akshay: test reminder — run integration smoke: `make smoke-integration TAG=staged` before we go to 100%.

simon: saw a small bump in tokenization latency at 16:05 — +0.9% p95. Watching.

maria: docs PR merged at 16:12 UTC, published changelog-snap.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 50% completed at 16:20:09 UTC. No critical regressions detected in first window.

release-manager: proceeding to 100% in 10m if no alerts. Final thumbs? :eyes:

simon: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

akshay: :thumbsup: running final smoke now.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% completed at 16:31:44 UTC. Rollout ID r-2026-0317-rc2 marked healthy.

release-manager: official: move `staged` -> `latest` after 20m stable window and prod smoke pass. Will ping again before moving.

simon: monitoring continues, will escalate if anything.

release-manager: thanks everyone — release notes and deprecation email scheduled. Closing thread when `latest` flip done.
